rounds.text: Eastern Silk Industries Ltd trades at an attractive valuation with a price-to-book ratio of 0.98x against a book value of ₹ 71.7 [E1], while offering a favorable P/E ratio of 6.59x compared to the sector benchmark of 16.15x [E5] and an EV/EBITDA of 4.2x against a sector benchmark of 9.02x [E10]. Operational efficiency metrics show real strength, featuring an ROA of 11.6% towering over the sector benchmark of 3.07% [E7], and an impressive ROCE of 17.55% that outpaces the sector benchmark of 8% [E9]. Market momentum is robustly behind the company, evidenced by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E43], a twelve-month price return of 80.5% [E44], and a share price sitting comfortably above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E42]. Furthermore, insider alignment is extraordinarily high, with promoters aggressively increasing their stake to 90.00% as of June 2026, up significantly from 51.28% in September 2023 [E37]. Conceded: [E13], [E14], [E31], [E34], [E56].
